components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one red CTA — start / save / commit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #FF2D2D; color: #fff; padding: 16px; width: 100%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 14px; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), opacity 160ms; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Resume Button
components.description: Inverted CTA shown when a workout is in progress.
components.css: .ds-btn-resume { background: #fff; color: #FF2D2D; padding: 16px; width: 100%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; border: 2px solid #FF2D2D; border-radius: 14px; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-resume:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Surface-2 field with a soft focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: oklch(95.5% 0.005 255); border: 1px solid oklch(85% 0.006 255); color: oklch(13% 0.005 255); padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; width: 100%; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(65% 0.005 255); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(55% 0.006 255); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(85% 0.006 255); }

components.name: PR Badge
components.description: Signature record marker — states the fact, then stops.
components.css: @keyframes ds-pr-pop { 0% { transform: scale(0.7); opacity: 0; } 60% { transform: scale(1.15); } 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } } .ds-pr { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #FF2D2D; color: #fff; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 2px; line-height: 1.2; animation: ds-pr-pop 350ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1) both; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-pr { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview: Raw is a measuring tool, not an app you experience — a stark white field, one decisive red mark, and a number large enough to read at arm's length under bright gym light. Every surface answers one question (did you beat last time?) and gets out of the way. Light by default and committed to it; color rationed to a single red signal that means act, live, or record. It rejects the generic SaaS dashboard, the bloated consumer fitness app, and the corporate-clinical spreadsheet.
keyCharacteristics: One voice of color — red under 10% of any screen, always meaningful.
Light, stark, daylight-proof; no dark mode.
System sans only; zero web-font payload.
Thumb-first with a fixed glass bottom-nav spine.
Honest, state-bearing motion with full reduced-motion fallbacks.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Red is used on ≤10% of any screen and only ever means act, live, or record. If red appears for decoration, delete it.

rules.name: The Legibility Floor Rule
rules.body: Real, must-read information never renders lighter than Steel (oklch(52%, 5.5:1 on white). Mist and Fog are at-a-glance captions only.

rules.name: The Number-As-Hero Rule
rules.body: On any screen the single most important figure is the largest, heaviest, darkest element. Shrink competing chrome.

rules.name: The Quiet Caption Rule
rules.body: Captions are 500-weight and small, never bold-and-loud. Build hierarchy by letting the number shout.

rules.name: The Etched-Not-Floated Rule
rules.body: Cards earn separation from a 1px border-subtle plus a one-step surface lift, never a drop shadow.

dos: Do make the most important number the largest, heaviest, darkest element on the screen.
Do ration red to act / live / record and keep it under ~10% of any view.
Do put primary actions in the bottom thumb zone and keep tap targets ≥44px.
Do separate cards with a 1px border-subtle plus surface lift, not a shadow.
Do pair every PR/live/record signal with a label or icon, never color alone.
Do keep all real, readable text at Steel (oklch(52%) or darker.
Do ship a prefers-reduced-motion fallback for every animation.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard — no gradient hero-metric tiles, pastel charts, or cards-everywhere sameness.
Don't add consumer-fitness dopamine theatre — no confetti, streak spam, or badges.
Don't drift corporate-clinical — keep athletic weight and high contrast.
Don't render must-read text in Fog (oklch(80%, 1.9:1); keep readable text at Mist (oklch(54%) or darker.
Don't put a colored stripe on the side of a card; the only heavy accent edge is the PR card's 3px top border.
Don't use a second hue — green is for completed goals only.
Don't add a drop shadow to a card or a web font to the bundle.
